title: Teaching
text: I teach courses in public administration and policy evaluation at Aarhus University, at both undergraduate and graduate level. My teaching draws on research in public policy, administrative behaviour, and quantitative methods.

title: Teaching
text:
Courses


Policy Evaluation
BA · Aarhus University · 2025, 2026
Undergraduate course introducing students to the logic and practice of evaluating public policies. I serve as both lecturer and tutorial instructor, covering research design, causal inference, and applied examples from Danish and comparative policy contexts.


MA-Seminar in Public Administration
MA · Aarhus University · 2020, 2024
Graduate seminar covering advanced topics in public administration research, with a focus on theory, research design, and current debates in the field.


Public Administration and Economics

Undergraduate course examining the intersection of public administration and economic reasoning, including topics in public choice, bureaucratic behaviour, and welfare state organisation.

title: Teaching
text:
Supervision
I supervise master’s theses in public administration, public policy, and related areas. I have supervised 3 individual and 2 group theses (2025–2026), and served as internship supervisor for 7 students (2024–2026).
Students interested in thesis supervision in the areas of administrative burdens, citizen-state interactions, frontline workers, or political participation are welcome to reach out.

title: Aske Halling
text:
Assistant Professor · Aarhus University

I am an Assistant Professor at the Department of Political Science at Aarhus University. My research centers on encounters between citizens and the state, with three connected lines of work: the administrative burdens citizens experience when navigating public services; the legitimacy of those encounters and what demands citizens and policy makers consider acceptable; and how frontline workers perceive and respond to the citizens they serve.
I received my PhD from Aarhus University in 2023 and have published in journals such as Public Administration Review, Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory, and Public Administration. My work has been recognised with best paper awards at Politica (2024) and the ENPA Conference (2026).
